newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-TAIT TO PLAY ON WING IN COMBINATION SIDE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TAIT TO PLAY ON WING IN COMBINATION SIDE.

text.p: The British Lions selectors, while deciding against the expected shadow test line-up, have picked Scottish centre Allan Tait on the left wing in a combination side to play the Natal Sharks at Kings Park on Saturday.

Welshman Allan Bateman returns from injury to partner Scott Gibbs in the centre and Irish loose forward Eric Miller gains a chance to shine at number eight in the Lions team announced by manager Fran Cotton on Thursday.
"With so many of the guys playing well at the moment, it's given the selectors enormous difficulty and this team is by no means a shadow test team," Cotton said.
"It will take next Tuesday's match against the Emerging Springboks before we'll be in a position to understand fully what team we need to beat South Africa in the test series.
"We've got a lot of good rugby players playing well at the moment and we want to give them the opportunity to show what they can do, to convince us they should be in the 21 for the first test."
The switch of Tait to the wing is one of several combinations the selectors will be looking at on Saturday.

"Playing Allan Tait on the wing gives us another option. He's one of several players who is come through well and we wanted to see various combinations playing in the three tough matches we'll have had against Super 12 teams in the space of 10 days," Lions coach Ian McGeechan said.

Cotton said that England winger Tony Underwood, carried off against the Gauteng Lions on Wednesday with a neck injury, had a clean bill of health after X-rays on Thursday. "He'll be available for selection on Tuesday."
Cotton also said that Irish lock Jeremy Davidson would have partnered Lions captain Martin Johnson on Saturday had he not tweaked his hamstring in training on Thursday.
"He'll be fully fit and buzzing in a couple of days -- there was no point in rushing him," Cotton said.

British Lions: Neil Jenkins; Ieuan Evans, Allan Bateman, Scott Gibbs, Allan Tait; Gregor Townsend, Rob Howley; Eric Miller, Richard Hill, Lawrence Dallaglio, Martin Johnson (captain), Simon Shaw, David Young, Keith Wood, Tom Smith. Replacements: Nick Bal, Mike Catt, Matt Dawson, Mark Regan, Jason Leonard, Rob Wainwright.
